original_title: How the killing of a French far-right activist sparked an online manhunt

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: The killing of a French far-right activist has sparked tensions between far-right and far-left groups, leading to online manhunts and potential for further violence.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased tensions and potential for clashes between opposing groups ahead of municipal elections.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Long-term escalation of violence between far-right and far-left groups, potentially affecting social stability and security in France.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Potential disruptions to transport and logistics due to protests and clashes, but no direct impact on aviation or cargo at this time.
